package.description: 智慧中小学是中华人民共和国教育部主办的集学生学习、教师教学、学校治理、教育创新等功能于一体的综合服务平台。

en-US.description: Smart Schools is a comprehensive service platform sponsored by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China that integrates the functions of student learning, teacher teaching, school governance, and educational innovation.
en-US.longDescription: The National Intelligent Education Platform for Primary and Secondary Schools is an education platform launched by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. It is the National Intelligent Education Platform for Primary and Secondary Schools Construction and Application Program developed by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China on the basis of summarizing the experience of the “National Primary and Secondary Schools Network Cloud Platform” and upgrading the original cloud platform into the “National Intelligent Education Platform for Primary and Secondary Schools”. The original cloud platform has been upgraded to the “National Wisdom Education Platform for Primary and Secondary Schools”. The platform includes 10 sections of resources, including moral education, curriculum teaching, physical education, aesthetic education, labor education, after-school services, teacher training, family education, education reform experience and teaching materials.
en-US.name: Smart Schools
en-US.publisher: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China

zh-CN.description: 智慧中小学是中华人民共和国教育部主办的集学生学习、教师教学、学校治理、教育创新等功能于一体的综合服务平台。
zh-CN.longDescription: 国家中小学智慧教育平台是中华人民共和国教育部推出的教育平台，是中华人民共和国教育部在总结“国家中小学网络云平台”运行服务经验的基础上，研究制定的《国家中小学智慧教育平台建设与应用方案》，并将原云平台改版升级为“国家中小学智慧教育平台”。平台包括德育、课程教学、体育、美育、劳动教育、课后服务、教师研修、家庭教育、教改经验和教材10个版块资源。
zh-CN.moniker: 国家中小学智慧教育平台
zh-CN.name: 智慧中小学
zh-CN.publisher: 中华人民共和国教育部
